eligibility.advisoryBoundary: UI exposes HOLD to every player, pass only to the projected priority holder, and Resolve only to the projected steward; every command is rechecked by the server and Core

supported: every player may assert or clear HOLD
the current priority holder may answer with a visible own-hand targetless Instant or Flash spell or explicitly pass
all seated players passing over a nonempty stack reaches resolution-ready for the captured top object
only the current stack steward may resolve that captured top object
deferred: automatic Oracle resolution beyond the existing Core or an explicit Manual Resolve

outcomes.unavailable: the control makes no attempt and shows the projected reason when HOLD, priority, steward, connection, or stack-top requirements are not met
outcomes.accepted: the sender receives a safe tabletop receipt and both seats observe the accepted revision, priority progression, captured stack top, and post-resolution shared state
outcomes.rejected: stale, wrong-actor, HOLD-blocked, wrong-steward, or wrong-top operations leave revision and Core state unchanged
outcomes.failed: an ordinary-command priority bypass, silent no-op, divergent seat projection, uncaptured top resolution, or missing receipt fails the journey

sameSlice: PublicOnlineControllerV3 submitPersonalAction and Remote GameScreen priority pass through that PersonalWorkbench adapter
ordinary online-command priority pass accepted by the public runtime
Remote surface or controller expectations that permit the PersonalWorkbench pass adapter
retained: Standalone PersonalWorkbench view and DisplayPairing prototype assets outside PublicOnlineControllerV3 and the production GameScreen route
Manual Stack and Manual Resolve for unsupported card semantics

positive: HOLD set and clear converge for both seats
each accepted tabletop pass advances exactly one revision and the projected priority holder
all seated passes converge on resolution-ready for the same stack top
steward Resolve advances exactly one revision and both seats observe the same stack removal and recent resolution
negative: HOLD blocks pass, response cast, advance, resolve, and SBA outcome without a client attempt when projected
server and Core reject wrong-holder, active-HOLD, stale-revision, wrong-steward, and wrong-top operations without state change
ordinary online-command priority-pass cannot bypass the tabletop server binder
non-steward and lower-stack controls cannot resolve the current top
